name: Totsuka Yukio
source:
Production assistant for "The Wandering Angels." He approached [url=/c73545]Hitomi[/url] at the Hachiko statue at around 10 AM with fliers for their upcoming production of [I]Au Revoir[/I].

He was sent by the producer, [url=/c129739]Sukozawa[/url], to retrieve the actor Akiomi Mondo from his apartment, who was being staked by [url=/c93374]debt[/url] [url=/c93375]collectors[/url]. During the performance, when novice actor [url=/c129988]Takuya Amo[/url] forgot to attach wires for a stunt, Tozuka improvised by entering onstage as "Assassin with an Edo Accent No. 1" and attaching the wire. Sukozawa assigned Tozuka, Amo, and [url=/c129986]Shin'ichi Bando[/url] to return the defective dry ice machine to [url=/c74743]Endo Electronics[/url].

[Edited from in-game TIPS]

[spoiler]Once [url=/c73543]Minorikawa[/url] informed them that they could discard the dry ice machine, the trio allowed [url=/c73541]Kano[/url] to take it, using it to deactivate [url=/c74615]Alphard[/url]'s bomb and save the Scramble.[/spoiler]
